text.short: Red wine and cola, half and half, over ice. The festival drink.
text.note: Unlike the Picon Punch, this one is drunk in the Basque Country too — it is said to have been mixed at a Basque festival in the 1970s.

etymology.gloss: the origin of the name is disputed

kin.how: the other Basque American drink, and the one that stayed here
where it is poured by the thousand
